title_zh: 清华园场所声景与口述史升级基线协议
purpose: Evaluate how people understand and experience the railway place, acoustic environment and interpretation context before changing the existing installation or adding content.
method_boundary: ISO/TS 12913-2 is used only as a background method for the people–acoustic environment–context triad. GB 3096 functional zones and limits are not assigned by this proposal and require authorised professional confirmation.
evidence_entry_condition: E3 begins only after operator permission, professional acoustic leadership, content-rights review, participant notice and a signed Listening Receipt.

baseline_windows.initial_plan: Eight attended windows covering weekday/weekend and morning/day/evening conditions, expanded when event, maintenance or seasonal context materially changes.
baseline_windows.sampling_note: This is qualitative/operational baseline design, not a claim of statistical representativeness.

field_method: Inventory retained station/railway elements, existing sound equipment, playback controls, maintenance status, content, rights and accessibility.
Run attended soundwalks that separately record people, acoustic environment and context; avoid unattended continuous recording by default.
Use short professional acoustic measurements only under an approved method, calibrated equipment and authority-confirmed functional-zone interpretation.
Collect participant appraisal, place-history comprehension, unwanted/forced exposure, quiet-time conflict and preferred interpretation channel.
Co-curate verified text, sign, tactile material and only short licensed audio; every item receives provenance, rightsholder, scope, expiry and withdrawal status.
Test a physical off control and staffed interpretation before any digital expansion.

candidate_metrics.candidate_threshold: 100% for content released to the public
100% of operating windows retain at least one verified non-audio and one staffed/physical alternative
set after the baseline; report by participant group
set with operator, residents and acoustic professional; serious uncontrolled disturbance triggers pause
proposed maximum five working days for disabling disputed digital content, subject to operator agreement

stop_conditions: raw personal audio retained without approved necessity and safeguards
uncertainty: Existing equipment condition, operator, content rights, acoustic functional zone, calibrated baseline and participant evidence have not been verified.
